text:
The cascodes cannot work here: the PMOS diode load takes 1.16 V, which leaves only about 0.4 V between the pair's source node and n1. That pushes the cascodes into triode and the tail to the edge of saturation. The likely result is the CMRR collapse and the PSRR loss from mismatched supply tracking between the two halves of the first stage.

The fix is a plain two-stage amplifier with no cascodes and longer channels on the pair, mirror load, second stage and tail for gain. PSRR should then come out around the gain plus 10 dB from the output-node conductance ratio.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Cascodes are in triode because the 1.16 V PMOS diode leaves no headroom, likely killing CMRR and PSRR. Removing them and using long-L pair, load, second stage and tail (all saturated) should restore gain >95 dB, so PSRR ≈ gain + 10 dB. Wider Rz/Cc ranges target phase margin."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (18.0, 12.0, 22.0),     # diff pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (2.0, 1.0, 3.0),        # diff pair L
    "itail": (8e-6, 5e-6, 12e-6),    # tail current
    "gmid4": (11.0, 7.0, 14.0),      # PMOS mirror load gm/Id
    "L4":    (2.0, 1.0, 3.0),        # PMOS mirror L
    "gmid7": (13.0, 9.0, 15.5),      # 2nd stage PMOS gm/Id
    "L7":    (1.5, 0.5, 2.5),        # 2nd stage L
    "i7":    (28e-6, 18e-6, 34e-6),  # 2nd stage current
    "cc":    (1.2e-12, 0.7e-12, 2.0e-12),
    "rz_k":  (1.3, 0.8, 3.0),        # Rz = rz_k*(1+CL/Cc)/gm7
    "Lb":    (2.0, 1.0, 3.0),        # bias/tail/M8 L
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    CL = spec.get("cl", 2e-12); iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = spec.get("vdd", 1.8); vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    it, i1, i7, cc = p["itail"], p["itail"] / 2, p["i7"], p["cc"]

    # ---- bias: Iref diode MB0, tail and M8 mirror it (same gm/Id, L) ----
    gb, Lb = 14.0, p["Lb"]
    mb0 = lut.size("n", gb, Lb, iref, vds=0.65)

    # ---- second stage PMOS ----
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmid7"], p["L7"], i7, vds=vdd - vcm)
    vout1 = vdd - m7.vgs
    # ---- PMOS mirror load ----
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid4"], p["L4"], i1, vds=0.5 * (m7.vgs + 1.1))
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid4"], p["L4"], i1, vds=m3.vgs)
    m4 = lut.size("p", p["gmid4"], p["L4"], i1, vds=vdd - vout1)
    vn1 = vdd - m3.vgs

    # ---- diff pair (with body effect) ----
    vs = 0.25
    for _ in range(4):
        m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], i1, vds=max(vn1 - vs, 0.1), vsb=vs)
        vs = vcm - m1.vgs
    mt = lut.size("n", gb, Lb, it, vds=max(vs, 0.12))
    m8 = lut.size("n", gb, Lb, i7, vds=vcm)

    gm7 = m7.gm
    rz = p["rz_k"] * (1 + CL / cc) / gm7

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb0)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("M1", "n1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "o1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "n1", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m4)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    n.R("RZ", "o1", "cz", rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", cc)

    # ---- predictions ----
    gm1 = m1.gm
    A1 = gm1 / (m4.gds + m1.gds)
    A2 = gm7 / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1 * A2)
    psrr_db = db(A1 * A2 * (m7.gds + m8.gds) / m7.gds)
    cmrr_db = db(2 * gm1 * m3.gm / (mt.gds * (m4.gds + m1.gds)))
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cc)
    C1 = m7.cgg + m4.cdd + m1.cdd + 5e-15
    C2 = CL + m8.cdd + m7.cdd
    wp2 = gm7 * cc / (C1 * C2 + cc * (C1 + C2))
    wp3 = 1.0 / (rz * C1)
    dz = rz - 1.0 / gm7
    wz = 1.0 / (cc * dz) if abs(dz) > 1e-9 else 1e15
    wm = m3.gm / (m3.cgg + m4.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd)
    wc = 2 * PI * ugbw
    ph = 90 + math.degrees(math.atan(wc / wp2) + math.atan(wc / wp3) + math.atan(wc / wm)
                          - math.atan(wc / (2 * wm)) - math.atan(wc / wz) * (1 if dz > 0 else -1))
    pm = 180 - ph
    slew = 0.8 * min(it / cc, i7 / (CL + cc))
    settle = 0.5 / slew + 4.6 / wc * (1.3 if pm < 70 else 1.0)
    swing = vdd - m7.vdsat - m8.vdsat - 0.1
    power = vdd * (iref + it + i7)
    kT4 = 4 * 1.38e-23 * 300.15
    s_th = 2 * kT4 * (2 / 3) / gm1 * (1 + m4.gm / gm1)
    KFn, KFp = 2.5e-10, 0.8e-10
    s_fl = 2 * (KFn / (m1.W * m1.L * 1e3) + (m4.gm / gm1) ** 2 * KFp / (m4.W * m4.L * 1e3))
    noise = 1.7 * math.sqrt(s_th + s_fl)

    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
               "psrr_db": psrr_db, "cmrr_db": cmrr_db, "slew": slew,
               "settle": settle, "swing": swing, "noise_1k": noise}
```
